name: pstack-herdr
description: Lets pstack use agents from other companies through Herdr: Codex (GPT), Antigravity (Gemini) and Grok. When a pstack seat names a non-Claude model, it is started as its own agent in a Herdr tab instead of quietly running on Claude. Run /pstack-herdr first: it checks which agents and models this machine has, runs pstack's own setup, then spreads the review seats across the companies it found. Needs the pstack plugin and Herdr.
